facts.fact: Himbol Community Financial Services' terms effective November 2025 describe the M-Nakfa mobile money wallet as in operation for cash-in, cash-out, person-to-person transfers, merchant payments and utility bill settlements, under Bank of Eritrea oversight.

ERI.note: Interoperability and a national switch are not stated.
Utility bill settlements through the wallet are not tax or fee payments to the state.
